ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there is a circle, and the four points A, B, C, D are all on the circle. Point B is above the circle, point A is at the lower left, point C is on the right side, and point D is below. Chords BA, BD, CA, CD are drawn in the figure; the angle formed by BA and BD at point B is labeled (x+24)°, and the angle formed by CA and CD at point C is labeled 3x°. Reasoning: ∠ABD and ∠ACD are both inscribed angles, and they both intercept the same arc AD, so these two inscribed angles are equal. Therefore x+24 = 3x. Solving gives 24 = 2x, so x = 12. The required m∠B = x+24 = 12+24 = 36°.
